entities.name: Decompensated cirrhosis
observations: Study population: adults referred for liver-transplant evaluation in the urinary-sodium/diastolic dysfunction cohort.

entities.name: DD-low UNa24h association
observations: Prospective assessment of 115 adults with decompensated cirrhosis found diastolic dysfunction in 66 (57.3%); adjusted UNa24h was inversely associated with dysfunction (OR 0.98, 95% CI 0.97–0.99, p=0.004); scale and threshold unavailable in the abstract.
This cohort supports association, not causality; diastolic dysfunction groups had similar Child-Pugh/MELD severity and survival.
